resources.string: Missed an entry? Re-read your inbox and log anything Kosha does not already have.
Logged %1$d, %2$d waiting for review, %3$d already recorded — from %4$d messages.
Safe to run again — anything already logged is merged, never duplicated.
This build has no SMS access, so messages cannot be scanned. Install the full build to capture bank alerts automatically. Manual and photo entry work as normal.
